# Lab 12.15: Deploy a Cloud Armor WAF Policy

## What We Are Going to Do
Put a web server behind a global external Application Load Balancer and protect it with Cloud Armor WAF, IP and rate-limit rules.

## Steps

1. **Create a small backend.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instance-templates create web-tpl --machine-type=e2-micro --tags=web \
  --metadata=startup-script='apt-get update; apt-get install -y nginx'
gcloud compute instance-groups managed create web-mig --template=web-tpl --size=1 --zone=us-central1-a
gcloud compute instance-groups set-named-ports web-mig --named-ports=http:80 --zone=us-central1-a
gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-lb-hc --network=default --allow=tcp:80 \
  --source-ranges=130.211.0.0/22,35.191.0.0/16 --target-tags=web</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create the load balancer.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute health-checks create http web-hc --port=80
gcloud compute backend-services create web-bes --global --protocol=HTTP \
  --health-checks=web-hc --load-balancing-scheme=EXTERNAL_MANAGED
gcloud compute backend-services add-backend web-bes --global \
  --instance-group=web-mig --instance-group-zone=us-central1-a
gcloud compute url-maps create web-map --default-service=web-bes
gcloud compute target-http-proxies create web-proxy --url-map=web-map
gcloud compute forwarding-rules create web-fr --global --target-http-proxy=web-proxy \
  --ports=80 --load-balancing-scheme=EXTERNAL_MANAGED
gcloud compute forwarding-rules describe web-fr --global --format="value(IPAddress)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Wait a few minutes until `curl http://LB_IP` returns the nginx page.

3. **Create the Cloud Armor policy and rules.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute security-policies create web-waf

gcloud compute security-policies rules create 1000 --security-policy=web-waf \
  --expression="evaluatePreconfiguredWaf('sqli-v33-stable', {'sensitivity': 1})" --action=deny-403

gcloud compute security-policies rules create 1100 --security-policy=web-waf \
  --expression="evaluatePreconfiguredWaf('xss-v33-stable', {'sensitivity': 1})" --action=deny-403

gcloud compute security-policies rules create 500 --security-policy=web-waf \
  --src-ip-ranges=198.51.100.0/24 --action=deny-403

gcloud compute security-policies rules create 2000 --security-policy=web-waf \
  --src-ip-ranges="*" --action=throttle \
  --rate-limit-threshold-count=100 --rate-limit-threshold-interval-sec=60 \
  --conform-action=allow --exceed-action=deny-429 --enforce-on-key=IP</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Attach it to the backend service.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute backend-services update web-bes --global --security-policy=web-waf</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://LB_IP/"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://LB_IP/?id=1'%20OR%20'1'='1"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://LB_IP/?q=&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The first returns `200`. The SQL injection and XSS requests return `403`.

6. **See the decisions.** In **Logs Explorer**, filter `resource.type="http_load_balancer"` and expand `jsonPayload.enforcedSecurityPolicy`.

7. **Clean up** in reverse order.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute forwarding-rules delete web-fr --global --quiet
gcloud compute target-http-proxies delete web-proxy --quiet
gcloud compute url-maps delete web-map --quiet
gcloud compute backend-services delete web-bes --global --quiet
gcloud compute security-policies delete web-waf --quiet
gcloud compute health-checks delete web-hc --quiet
gcloud compute instance-groups managed delete web-mig --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute instance-templates delete web-tpl --quiet
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete allow-lb-hc --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Normal request | `200` |
| SQL injection and XSS | `403` from Cloud Armor |
| Too many requests | `429` from the rate-limit rule |
| Tip | Use `--preview` on a rule to log without blocking first |
